Parity guard: vpvoice/rules.py refuses at import any rules.json key, builtin, scope or enum it does not implement, so an engine change breaks CI at load, not quietly in a call

Caller-crisis judge (judge.json): raise-only, default shadow, 800 ms bound, in parallel with the brain; raise interrupts the turn with the crisis path; off unless VP_LLM_SAFETY_JUDGE_* (or DEFAULT) is configured; raise in production only on the owner's go
Judge runtime events (shared/runtime-protocol.ts 'judge', 8ece232): one per judged turn with an outcome (raised / shadow / unavailable), never caller text; only a raise is also a safety event

Reply door = shared rules.json evaluated as index.ts does (all 1186 vectors pass) + runtime layer (first-breath clause, truth first, crisis lines); block -> one rewrite told the rule, then a safe line
Caller signals and redaction from rules.json; redacted text is what reaches transcript, events and the LLM
Transports: sim (text socket), webrtc (lab-style browser socket), sip (Plivo outbound dial + stream, Plivo/Exotel inbound streams, Plivo transfer for phone hand-off)
Admission cap per process (VP_MAX_CALLS_PER_PROCESS, default 20): 503 at_capacity + Retry-After, placed:false, before anything is created; health shows capacity {admitted, max, free}

python -m vpvoice.launch: one worker per core behind one port (front: least-loaded placement, overflow, owner routing, summed health; /w/<i>/ media prefix; restart with back-off). 4 workers carry 90 calls on the 4-vCPU sandbox at lag p99 8.3 ms (bench/results)

Live controls: POST /v1/calls/{id}/{listen|whisper|takeover} (signed, body names the call). Whisper = untrusted note in the LAST block, doored reply; listen = receive-only mixed socket, never recorded; takeover = she stops for good (cut at a sentence end within 300 ms), doored hand-off line, hand_off target member:<id>, member bridged both ways, a member drop closes the call; supervisor moments (live_listen_started/ended per listener, whisper without text, takeover) per runtime-protocol.ts at 3a84688

contractGaps: call.ended has no field for the failure reason when endReason = error; it is logged and in GET /v1/calls/{id} only
The signature does not cover method or path; the runtime closes the replay hole on /end by requiring conversationId in the body
brief.hash is checked as sha256 hex of brief.text (optionally sha256:-prefixed); the control plane must hash the same way
Control-plane brief compiler should use the marker vocabulary in README (<end_call>, <goal:ID>, <tool:NAME>, <handoff:REASON>)
runtime-client.ts treats 503 at_capacity as a failed attempt (provider_error, ladder step); proposed to calls: a retryable not-placed reply

runtime-client.ts control('end') sends {} but the runtime requires {conversationId}; StartReply.join shape (expiresAt string, url/token) differs from what the runtime returns (expiresAtMs; sip has answerUrl/hangupUrl/streamUrl); whisper/takeover/listen are not implemented
decisions: In a crisis, ticket limits stretch to 2x; at the ceiling the call is handed off (crisis_handoff); her <end_call> is ignored and a request for a human never ends the call unless a live transfer takes it
A recording refusal discards the whole recording, not just the rest of the call
Vertex is chosen once per call; 5xx retries stay on the same model and route
neverSay hits are reported under RD7, as the shared rules do
v2-live (Gemini Live) holds each turn until its transcript has passed the door: safe, but slower; recommend no production calls on it until its latency is measured with the hold

Gemini runs on Vertex only (decision.2026-10-21.gemini-vertex-only): no Gemini API key, no OpenRouter Gemini; a model or Live feature Vertex does not offer makes the stack unavailable with a plain reason, never a reroute. Only from an Indian VP_REGION. Live needs VERTEX_LIVE_LOCATION (no default: the docs list gemini-3.8-live in us/eu/us-central1 only)
